summary: 20 features and 3 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • autotask: add manual hero override for auto task sessions (80923a5)
  • health: extend health check with ping-pong validation mode (32f528e)
  • orleans: implement isolated workdir support in ClaudeCodeGrain (5e7d405)
  • claude-helper: extend session options for isolated workdir (5d28e0e)
  • frontend-config: add Claude Code isolated workdir setting (6d06ed5)

HagiCode-org/web

  • signalr: enhance streaming tool use metadata resolution (01c1d1e)
  • conversation: add thinking process block component (6196a75)
  • ui-master: add scene settings loading and captain fallback support (3ff97a7)
  • layout: enhance LayoutSwitcher with visual previews and improved UX (7ea7025)
  • statusbar: remove ad promotions and simplify announcement flow (502a194)
  • ui-master: add command preview with visual themes and improved layout (84aa9f4)
  • settings: add Claude Code settings tab with isolated workdir configuration (0e92831)
  • signalr: add streaming tool use aggregation and content block merging (e0abeb5)
  • settings: consolidate session list settings into unified tab (5fce09d)
  • wizard: add Hagicoder bootstrap step to initialization wizard (8dc6e66)
  • session: add GitHub repository marker to session list (e362837)
  • pwa: add progressive web app support (e8818b3)
  • vscode: pass connection token to desktop code server window (fca1fcb)
  • drawer: add overlayClassName prop for custom overlay styling (29d82e7)
  • proposal: add repository search to selector (a6c10b2)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/web

  • ui: remove CLI version from monitoring indicator and fix dispatch (454fd54)
  • session: correct dropdown tooltip nesting structure (47e161c)
  • statusbar: simplify Hagipower trigger animation for stability (73c4ff1)
